items.text: Saturday morning came. <break time="0.8s" /> And the whole summer world. <break time="0.8s" /> Was bright and fresh. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a song. <break time="0.8s" /> In every heart. <break time="0.8s" /> And the trees were full of flowers. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom came out. <break time="0.8s" /> Onto the sidewalk with a bucket of whitewash. <break time="0.8s" /> And a long brush. <break time="0.8s" /> He looked at the fence. <break time="0.8s" /> And all the joy. <break time="0.8s" /> Left him. <break time="0.8s" /> It was thirty yards. <break time="0.8s" /> Of board fence. <break time="0.8s" /> Nine feet high. <break time="0.8s" /> Life seemed empty to him. <break time="0.8s" /> And living was a heavy burden. <break time="0.8s" /> Sighing he dipped his brush. <break time="0.8s" /> And passed it. <break time="0.8s" /> Along the top board. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he compared. <break time="0.8s" /> The small white line. <break time="0.8s" /> With the huge fence. <break time="0.8s" /> He sat down on a box. <break time="0.8s" /> Feeling hopeless.

토요일 아침이 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 여름 세상 전체가. <break time="0.8s" /> 밝고 상쾌했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 노래가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 모든 마음속에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나무들은 꽃으로 가득했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 나왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 보도로 흰 칠 한 양동이와. <break time="0.8s" /> 긴 붓을 들고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 울타리를 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 모든 기쁨이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그를 떠났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 30야드였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 판자 울타리의. <break time="0.8s" /> 높이 9피트의. <break time="0.8s" /> 삶은 그에게 텅 빈 것 같았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 사는 것은 무거운 짐이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한숨을 쉬며 그는 붓을 담갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것을 움직였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 맨 위 판자를 따라. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그는 비교했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 흰 줄을. <break time="0.8s" /> 거대한 울타리와. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 상자 위에 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 절망감을 느끼며.

Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> Jim came skipping. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of the gate. <break time="0.8s" /> With a tin bucket. <break time="0.8s" /> He was going to bring water. <break time="0.8s" /> From the town pump. <break time="0.8s" /> Jim, I will get the water. <break time="0.8s" /> If you whitewash some. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Tom. <break time="0.8s" /> But Jim shook his head. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran away. <break time="0.8s" /> Afraid of Aunt Polly. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom began to think of all the fun. <break time="0.8s" /> He had planned for this day. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon the free boys. <break time="0.8s" /> Would come by and laugh at him. <break time="0.8s" /> For having to work. <break time="0.8s" /> He looked in his pockets. <break time="0.8s" /> But he had only. <break time="0.8s" /> Some toys and pieces of junk. <break time="0.8s" /> It was not enough. <break time="0.8s" /> To buy even half an hour. <break time="0.8s" /> Of freedom. <break time="0.8s" /> At this dark and hopeless moment. <break time="0.8s" /> A great idea. <break time="0.8s" /> Burst upon him. <break time="0.8s" /> It was nothing less than a great, magnificent idea. <break time="0.8s" /> He took up his brush. <break time="0.8s" /> And went quietly to work.

바로 그때. <break time="0.8s" /> 짐이 깡충깡충 뛰어나왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 대문 밖으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 양철 양동이를 들고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 물을 가져올 참이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마을 펌프에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 짐, 내가 물을 길어 올게. <break time="0.8s" /> 네가 좀 칠해 주면. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 짐은 고개를 저었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 달아났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 폴리 이모가 무서워서. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 떠올리기 시작했다 모든 재미있는 일들을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 오늘을 위해 계획했던. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 자유로운 아이들이. <break time="0.8s" /> 지나갈 것이다 그리고 그를 비웃을 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 일해야 한다는 이유로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 주머니를 살펴보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그것밖에 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 장난감 몇 개와 잡동사니 조각들. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 충분하지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 30분조차 살 만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 자유의. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 어둡고 절망적인 순간에. <break time="0.8s" /> 굉장한 생각이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그에게 번뜩 떠올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 그야말로 위대하고 웅장한 생각이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 붓을 집어 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 조용히 일을 시작했다.

Soon Ben Rogers came along. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose laughing Tom feared most. <break time="0.8s" /> He was eating an apple. <break time="0.8s" /> And pretending to be a big steamboat. <break time="0.8s" /> Ding dong dong, he called. <break time="0.8s" /> Turning in a slow circle. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a boat. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom went on whitewashing. <break time="0.8s" /> And paid no attention. <break time="0.8s" /> To the steamboat. <break time="0.8s" /> Hi, old boy. <break time="0.8s" /> You have to work. <break time="0.8s" /> Do you not said Ben. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom looked at him. <break time="0.8s" /> As if he were surprised. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Why, it is you, Ben. <break time="0.8s" /> What do you call work. <break time="0.8s" /> Why, is that not work. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked Ben. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, maybe it is and maybe it is not said Tom. <break time="0.8s" /> All I know is that it suits Tom Sawyer. <break time="0.8s" /> Does a boy get a chance. <break time="0.8s" /> To whitewash a fence. <break time="0.8s" /> Every day. <break time="0.8s" /> Ben stopped eating his apple. <break time="0.8s" /> And watched Tom. <break time="0.8s" /> With new interest.

곧 벤 로저스가 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 소년은. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰이 그의 웃음을 가장 두려워하는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 사과를 먹고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 커다란 증기선인 척하고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 딩 동 동, 그가 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 천천히 원을 그리며 돌면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 배처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 계속 칠했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 전혀 관심을 두지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 증기선에. <break time="0.8s" /> 야, 친구. <break time="0.8s" /> 너 일해야 하는구나. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇지 벤이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 그를 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 놀란 것처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어, 너구나, 벤. <break time="0.8s" /> 뭘 일이라고 부르는 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 아니, 그게 일이 아니야. <break time="0.8s" /> 벤이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 글쎄, 그럴 수도 있고 아닐 수도 있지 톰이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 아는 건 그게 톰 소여에게 맞는다는 것뿐이야. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이가 기회를 얻니. <break time="0.8s" /> 울타리를 칠할. <break time="0.8s" /> 매일. <break time="0.8s" /> 벤은 사과 먹기를 멈췄다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 톰을 지켜보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 새로운 관심을 가지고.

Tom swept his brush. <break time="0.8s" /> Back and forth. <break time="0.8s" /> Like an artist. <break time="0.8s" /> He stepped back. <break time="0.8s" /> To look at the effect. <break time="0.8s" /> And added a touch. <break time="0.8s" /> Here and there. <break time="0.8s" /> Ben watched every move. <break time="0.8s" /> And became more and more interested. <break time="0.8s" /> Say, Tom. <break time="0.8s" /> Let me whitewash a little. <break time="0.8s" /> He said at last. <break time="0.8s" /> No, Ben, I cannot. <break time="0.8s" /> Aunt Polly is very particular. <break time="0.8s" /> About this fence. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, please let me try. <break time="0.8s" /> I will give you. <break time="0.8s" /> The core of my apple. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, no, Ben. <break time="0.8s" /> I am afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Tom. <break time="0.8s" /> I will give you all of it. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Ben. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom gave up the brush. <break time="0.8s" /> With an unwilling face. <break time="0.8s" /> But a happy heart. <break time="0.8s" /> While Ben worked. <break time="0.8s" /> And sweated in the sun. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom sat in the shade. <break time="0.8s" /> And ate the apple.

톰은 붓을 휘둘렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 앞뒤로, 이리저리. <break time="0.8s" /> 화가처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 뒤로 물러섰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 효과를 보려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 붓질을 더했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 여기저기. <break time="0.8s" /> 벤은 모든 동작을 지켜보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 점점 더 흥미를 느꼈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 야, 톰. <break time="0.8s" /> 나도 좀 칠하게 해 줘. <break time="0.8s" /> 마침내 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 안 돼, 벤. <break time="0.8s" /> 폴리 이모가 매우 까다로우셔. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 울타리에 대해. <break time="0.8s" /> 아, 제발 해 보게 해 줘. <break time="0.8s" /> 너에게 줄게. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 사과 속심을. <break time="0.8s" /> 음, 안 돼, 벤. <break time="0.8s" /> 걱정돼서. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그거 전부 줄게. <break time="0.8s" /> 벤이 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 붓을 넘겨주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내키지 않는 얼굴로. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 기쁜 마음으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 벤이 일하는 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 햇볕 아래 땀을 흘리는 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 그늘에 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 사과를 먹었다.

Boys came by all afternoon. <break time="0.8s" /> And each one stayed. <break time="0.8s" /> To whitewash. <break time="0.8s" /> When Ben was tired. <break time="0.8s" /> Billy Fisher paid a kite. <break time="0.8s" /> For the next turn. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Johnny Miller bought in with a dead rat. <break time="0.8s" /> And a string. <break time="0.8s" /> To swing it with. <break time="0.8s" /> By the evening. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom was rich. <break time="0.8s" /> With treasures. <break time="0.8s" /> He had marbles. <break time="0.8s" /> A piece of blue glass. <break time="0.8s" /> A key that opened nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And a one eyed kitten. <break time="0.8s" /> The fence had three coats. <break time="0.8s" /> Of whitewash on it. <break time="0.8s" /> If he had not run out of whitewash. <break time="0.8s" /> Every boy in the village. <break time="0.8s" /> Would have been bankrupt. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom had discovered. <break time="0.8s" /> A great law of human action. <break time="0.8s" /> Without knowing it. <break time="0.8s" /> To make someone want a thing. <break time="0.8s" /> You only need to make it. <break time="0.8s" /> Hard to get. <break time="0.8s" /> Work is what a person must do and play is what a person does not have to do.

오후 내내 아이들이 들렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 각자 남았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 칠을 하려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 벤이 지치자. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌리 피셔가 연을 지불했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음 차례를 위해. <break time="0.8s" /> 그다음 조니 밀러가 사서 들어왔다 죽은 쥐 한 마리와. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 끈으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것을 휘두를. <break time="0.8s" /> 저녁 무렵에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 부자였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 보물로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그에게는 구슬이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 파란 유리 조각. <break time="0.8s" /> 아무것도 열지 못하는 열쇠. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 눈이 하나인 새끼 고양이. <break time="0.8s" /> 울타리에는 세 겹이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 흰 칠의. <break time="0.8s" /> 흰 칠이 떨어지지 않았더라면. <break time="0.8s" /> 마을의 모든 아이가. <break time="0.8s" /> 파산했을 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 톰은 발견했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 인간 행동의 위대한 법칙을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것을 알지도 못한 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 누군가가 무언가를 원하게 하려면. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것을 그렇게 만들기만 하면 된다. <break time="0.8s" /> 얻기 어렵게. <break time="0.8s" /> 일이란 사람이 해야만 하는 것이고, 놀이란 사람이 하지 않아도 되는 것이다.
